1.5.1: Graphics mode (syllabus 19): draw logos, icons and pictures with the shapes, pen, text, gradients and layers of Animation mode, on an image sized in pixels, centimetres, millimetres or inches at a resolution (A4, 10 × 10 cm, 200 × 200 px)
Line objects up and space them evenly (Align and Distribute, in Animation mode too); crop the canvas to the drawing or the selection; rulers and positions in the image's units
Export an image as SVG, PNG or JPG: at another width, height or printed size, with its resolution inside the file; the selected objects alone, or each in a file of its own named after it
Send to Animation: the drawing goes on as shapes to animate; copy and paste between the two modes
The colour picker shows a colour's RGB, HSL and CMYK numbers, and takes them typed (RGB 180,0,0)
Help ▸ About OneEditor (on a Mac, in the OneEditor menu): the version, the licence, and the website for contributors, codingspacekh.dev
1.5.0: The app is now called OneEditor, and it updates itself: new versions arrive without reinstalling

Video: a logo or a second video over the video (picture-in-picture); turn or flip a clip filmed sideways; insert a clip at the playhead; make the project the size of a clip; the music quieter between two times

Type any speed (such as 1.25×), a clip's start time in Audio mode, and any export size (such as 852 × 480); crop a picture to any shape; stretch a picture without cropping; place a picture on another picture
Sound effects: 66 built-in sounds (whoosh, ding, drum roll…) and two sound effects tracks in Video mode; six bold new fonts, ten new transitions and new title animations (slam, type on, spin)
Audio: Change tempo (same pitch), Reverse, Volume change, Remove silences; export 8-bit WAV and OGG
Animation: sounds; text along a curve; turn about any point; skew; flip; combine shapes (cut one out of another); gradients of three or more colours; crop a picture or make a colour see-through
Animation export: play once and stop, AVI and MOV, another width, a range of frames, a transparent stage, and the frame as an SVG picture
File ▸ Candidate Details…: every save and export suggests the exam's file name, such as Gas_ZZ999_9999
Help ▸ Report a Problem… saves a report to give your teacher when something goes wrong
